title: Ecological Succession
definition: The gradual, predictable, and directional process of change in the species structure of an ecological community over time, leading to a stable climax community.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims (Environment/Ecology) regarding community dynamics, biodiversity patterns, and ecosystem restoration; essential for Mains answers on climate change and habitat loss.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ecological Succession.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
